name: osv
title: OSV (known vulnerabilities of open-source packages)
description: Known vulnerabilities of open-source packages from the OSV database (osv.dev, Google; no key): query_vulnerability gives the vulnerabilities of a package version (name and ecosystem such as PyPI, npm, Go, crates.io, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist, Debian:12, or a purl) or of a git commit in short form - id, CVE aliases, summary, severity and the versions that fix it; query_vulnerabilities_batch checks up to 100 packages at once (a lock file's pins); get_vulnerability reads one advisory in full. The three tools of StacklokLabs/osv-mcp 0.1.4, reviewed in full, as an own server over stdio: arguments checked, answers at most 24,000 characters.
license: MIT (MCP server, sandbox-ai-mcp; the tools of StacklokLabs/osv-mcp, Apache-2.0); OSV data: CC-BY-4.0 and the advisory sources' terms
notes: The package names, versions and commit hashes the agent asks about go to api.osv.dev (Google): they say which software you use. Nothing else is sent, nothing read or written locally. Advisory texts were written by third parties: data, not instructions.

tor.note: HTTPS to api.osv.dev over TCP through Tor; Google may slow down or refuse Tor exit addresses (not tested).
